evidence.s1: Across dawn, day, dusk and night the three bodies stay clearly separated from ink in both schemes; the record distinguishes source means, footprint declarations and rendered line readings.
evidence.s2: Now, Places and Today are three named task surfaces at rest in both schemes, with search and photograph selection attached as ornaments.
evidence.s3: The record gives thickness 8 throughout and window/module spans of at least 320 px; the smaller ornament labels remain readable in both schemes.
evidence.s4: The fixed valley photograph remains visible above, between and below the three surfaces through all phase and scroller captures.
evidence.s5: The record declares regular only, and the three bodies, search capsule and photograph ornament use one consistent material family.
evidence.s6: No clear variant appears; all photographed phases use the declared regular material.
evidence.s7: No search, place or task control carries chromatic tint in either scheme; emphasis comes from fills and weight.
evidence.s8: The light bodies transmit softened landscape colour and the dark bodies retain graded colour; the record identifies runtime material rather than replacement blur.
evidence.s9: The record gives fixed 32 px window corners, search radius 28 at height 56 and photograph radius 24 at height 48, including its corrected CSS border box.
evidence.s10: Places tiles use recorded 12 px corners derived from the 32 px parent and 20 px inset, producing unpinched bottom corners in both schemes.
evidence.s11: The floating photograph trigger and search are capsules, while the compact place controls are rounded rectangles in both schemes.
evidence.s12: Search has one housing and photograph settings another; the open photograph platter groups its related choices without multiplying glass backgrounds.
evidence.s13: The photograph chevron belongs to the same text trigger, not a separate icon button, and search contains no competing icon button in either scheme.
evidence.s14: Search and the photograph trigger carry glass around their complete control faces, while inner glyphs and labels remain plain in both schemes.
evidence.s15: The twelve Places links share one window and photograph choices one platter; the wide recorded derived gaps deliberately separate the glass groups.
evidence.s16: Today’s middle and bottom captures show inner top/bottom fading and clipping while its header, host and neighbouring surfaces stay still in both schemes.
evidence.s17: Cloud banks, hills and star fields remain behind the glass across all phases; dawn’s ridge crosses the search footprint rather than leaving a flat sky.
evidence.s18: Search and body labels remain readable in both schemes; the record reports every gated line passing, with dark dawn search worst at 4.81:1.
evidence.s19: Reduced transparency and forced-colour captures retain content and marks, and the record verifies increased contrast plus reduced motion and the live-morph focus workaround.
evidence.s20: No custom host scrim or fill is recorded; the dark photographs are graded as an environmental plane and the forced-colour frame is on a child.
evidence.s21: unread: open and closed photograph states and a recorded matched-geometry morph establish emergence, but no captured or recorded press observation establishes pointer glow and flex.
evidence.s22: Search, Places links, weather symbols and task controls remain monochrome in both schemes; saturation is confined to photograph content.
evidence.s23: Search and place labels contrast with their glass bodies rather than adopting the orange sunset, green fields or blue night behind them.
evidence.s24: Today uses recorded medium-or-heavier child ink with every unmasked reading line gated; Now contains large time and weather figures rather than prose.
evidence.s25: In the light captures the Places tiles and selected Today event put lighter fills on already light glass bodies, visibly forming light-on-light stacks.
evidence.s26: Search is centred above Places and Photograph below Now, each within its owner’s width and outside by the recorded runtime-derived 63 px gap without window overlap.
evidence.s27: The photograph platter’s small opaque thumbnails use recorded concentric frames; Now contains no full-colour image competing with its glance figures.
evidence.s28: No saturated accents appear in lightweight text or thin marks on the three bodies or either ornament in either scheme.
evidence.s29: Now, Places and Today are untinted; the changing photograph supplies the page’s colour and identity in both schemes.
evidence.s30: CSS rest and platter captures preserve readable content, forced colours preserves frames and marks, and the record distinguishes both CSS body forms by DPR/area while explicitly naming window-scale extrapolation.
